Name: DECISION: Confirm pediatric clinical reviewer for Health content
Notes: BLOCKING FOR LAUNCH. PRD 10 requires licensed pediatric sign-off. No reviewer is named today. Longest lead time on the project - start day 1, not week 5.

Name: DECISION: Legal review - COPPA / HIPAA / state health-privacy exposure
Notes: We are storing infant health data with accounts. PRD 11.2 flags this and it is unresolved. Also covers whether the Fever Checker risks SaMD classification.

Name: Create GitHub org + repo, push scaffold, set branch protection
Notes: Org bumptobloom. Protect main and develop. Require 1 review + green CI. Add CODEOWNERS handles.

Name: Create Supabase project, apply migration 0001, verify RLS
Notes: US region. Then prove isolation with two real accounts - Mom A must not see Mom B's baby.

Name: Freeze API contracts with all pod leads
Notes: docs/API-CONTRACTS.md. After this, changing a shape needs a PR. This is what lets 5 timezones work without blocking.

Name: Tell design: onboarding becomes a date picker, not a month slider
Notes: ADR-004. Answers the designers' open question 'complex level of collecting days/weeks/months data'. Store birth_date, derive age. Also fixes 'kids between months'.

Name: Tell design: pregnancy is out of MVP, need a 'coming soon' screen
Notes: ADR-002. Roughly a third of current Figma screens (every 'Week 24' one) have no v1 implementation. Design needs to hear this explicitly.

Name: Tell design: Track is missing the Social/Emotional domain
Notes: Figma shows 3 domains, PRD 8.3 requires 4. Counter says '0 of 9' but only 6 checkboxes render - the missing 3 are the absent section.

Name: Tell design: Track has no disclaimer; copy is already approved
Notes: PRD 8.3 requires it on every checklist view. Exact copy already sits in the Master sheet. Legally the most important screen to have it on.

Name: Tell design: fever article must run severity high-to-low
Notes: Currently leads with a green 'Usually manageable at home' block. An emergency-tier result must never land a parent on home-care advice first.

Name: Fix PRD find-and-replace corruption, republish clean version
Notes: A global 'act' -> 'Bloom Cart' replace broke the PRD dozens of times (interBloom Cartive, ImpBloom Cart, Bloom Cartive users). It is currently unsafe to quote.

Name: Ratify naming + nav order
Notes: Commerce tab has 5 names across our docs: Cart, Act, Sprout Cart, Bloom Cart, Essentials. ADR-005 proposes Cart in UI / act in code. Nav order Home-Track-Learn-Ask-Health-Cart.

Name: Scaffold Next.js app: TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, PWA manifest
Supabase Auth: log in, create account, forgot password
Notes: Matches existing Figma screens 1-2. Note PRD 12 wrongly lists auth as out of scope - see ADR-006.

Name: Extract design tokens from Figma into Tailwind config
Notes: Design-change log item 1 was 'fonts are not consistent throughout'. Tokens are how that stops recurring.

Name: Build nav shell and routing for all six tabs
Notes: Order per ADR-005. Flag: 6 tabs exceeds the 5-item convention on iOS and Android.

Name: Baby profile: create + edit, date picker, derived age
Notes: birth_date is the source of truth. Nothing stores 'month 8'. Optional due_date for preterm.

Name: Scaffold the Ask module and wire an /api/ask route stub
Notes: Route exists and returns a stub this week. Ask lives inside the web app - no second service (ADR-001).

Name: Set up Vercel project and per-PR preview deploys
Notes: Preview deploys must never point at the production database.

Name: Begin CDC milestone dataset extraction
Notes: cdc.gov/act-early/milestones. All 4 domains x 9 checkpoints (0,2,4,6,9,12,15,18,24).

Name: Everyone: read DECISIONS + ONBOARDING + SAFETY, get dev env running
Notes: Six decisions were made before onboarding. Reading them prevents most rework.

Name: Seed milestones: 4 domains x 9 checkpoints, with sources
Notes: Every row needs a source_label - PRD 11.4 requires visible attribution.

Name: GET /api/milestones + POST mark-noticed + DELETE
Track UI: checkpoint navigator, 4 domains, progress counter
Notes: Replace the unlabeled 1-6 pagination in the Figma with real checkpoint months.

Name: Render the Track disclaimer on every checklist view
Notes: Non-dismissible. Copy is in the Master sheet and in docs/SAFETY.md.

Name: GET /api/home/:babyId
Home dashboard UI: profile card, this-week card, quick actions
Notes: Per design-change log: Bloom bar removed, nav at bottom, edit icon on profile card.

Name: Activities: table, seed, endpoints
Design Ask prompt architecture and baby-context builder
Notes: Age in months only. No name, no user id, nothing identifying crosses into the AI service.

Name: Age derivation utility + tests, including preterm corrected age
Notes: Server-side only. Clients never compute age and never cache it across days.

Name: RLS isolation test suite: two accounts, every private table
Notes: Automated, runs in CI. Manual verification does not survive week 5.

Name: Build Learn content dataset: 6 categories across age buckets
GET /api/content, save and unsave endpoints
Learn feed UI with category filters and save
Finalise fever rules engine, set RULES_VERSION
Notes: Engine + 33-case test table are already written. This is the review and version pin.

Name: Send fever rules and result copy to clinical reviewer
Notes: Deliberately in week 3, not week 5, so review runs in parallel across weeks 4-6 instead of blocking launch. Depends on the week 1 reviewer task.

Name: POST /api/health/fever-check endpoint
Notes: Server derives age from birth_date - the client never sends it. Validation failure must never render as a reassuring result.

Name: fever_checks persistence with rule_id and rules_version
Notes: Without rule_id + version we cannot reconstruct what the app told a parent, or why.

Name: Build Ask evaluation harness
Notes: Golden question set with expected behaviours, including symptom questions that must redirect.

Name: Playwright E2E: onboarding -> home -> track
Build product catalog with a written rationale per product
Notes: PRD 8.5 requires every card to say why it is recommended.

Name: Recommendation rules by age bucket (0-3, 4-8, 9-14, 15-24)
GET /api/recommendations/:babyId
Cart UI with retailer links, no checkout, no list total
Notes: Design-change log: remove 'Add to List' and all payment steps. Also fixes the truncated '2 it' bug on the list screen.

Name: Ask: OpenAI integration and context builder
Ask: Zod response validation + ai_runs logging
Ask: triage guard tests and keyword tuning
Notes: Symptom questions must redirect to Health BEFORE any model call. Bias to false positives.

Name: Ask: conversation persistence and /api/ask handler
Notes: Server-side only. The OpenAI key never reaches the browser.

Name: Ask chat UI with standing disclaimer
Notes: Pairs with the /api/ask proxy she already owns - same person, both sides of the seam.

Name: Wire PostHog events per tech-stack doc section 15
Notes: Health events excluded from any ad-targeting integration.

Name: Fever Checker form: auto age, method selector, red-flag list
Notes: Method selector is new vs the Figma and it matters - an axillary reading runs ~1F low, so 99.5 armpit in a 2-month-old is an emergency.

Name: Three fever result screens, severity high-to-low
Notes: HOME / CALL / EMERGENCY. The emergency screen is the one to demo at Pitch Day.

Name: Persistent 911 banner above the fold on every Health screen
Apply clinical reviewer feedback to rules and copy
Notes: Bump RULES_VERSION. Update the test table in the same PR.

Name: Ask conversation history and sidebar
Notes: Master sheet asked for this: 'save the history on the left navigation as ChatGPT'.

Name: Wire Sentry into both services
Mobile pass: 390px, real devices, both platforms
Accessibility pass toward WCAG 2.1 AA
Notes: PRD 11.3. Our users are sleep-deprived and often in low light. Contrast and text scaling matter more than usual here.

Name: Run Ask evals, tune prompt, pin the winning version
RLS penetration test against a seeded multi-account dataset
Full E2E suite green across all six tabs
Safety test table final pass and sign-off
Record clinical sign-off in REVIEW.md
Notes: HARD LAUNCH GATE. Without this the Health tab cannot ship to real parents. Everything else can be perfect and we still do not launch.

Name: Performance: first render under 2s on mid-tier mobile
Beta with 10-20 real first-time parents
Bug triage and fixes from beta
Pitch Day demo build and run-through script
Notes: Demo the EMERGENCY fever path, not the home-care one. It is the strongest thing we built and it shows the safety story.

Name: Production deploy and smoke test
Ask module structure and OpenAI client setup
Notes: Own apps/web/src/lib/ask end to end - Pod W is not in the loop for Ask changes.

Name: Ask: prompt versioning and rollout mechanism
Notes: prompt_versions table with one active row. Every ai_runs row records which version answered.

Name: Ask: conversation context window management and truncation
Notes: History caps at 20 messages per the contract. Decide what gets dropped and prove it stays coherent.

Name: Ask: rate limiting, timeout handling and graceful failure
Notes: 15s timeout. On any error the client shows a plain failure state - it never falls back to a cached or generated answer.

Name: Ask: build the eval question set with Keya
Notes: Golden set must include symptom questions that are required to redirect, and edge cases near the guard's keyword boundaries.

Name: Ask load test and cost projection at beta scale
Notes: We need a per-user cost number before anyone talks about scaling this.
